notes: claude-haiku55 on: measured with the current Pinocchio (2026-10-22, after the fixes below). The off and placebo arms have no live hook; their post-hoc verdicts were taken at run time with the version before the last two fixes.

The pre-fix Haiku 5.5 on-arm runs are kept in bench/results/haiku55-on-before-fix/ (with their labels): 2/75 false alarms and 1/24 false blocks, all from the bugs fixed above.
